footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to GE Vernova: includes a $2.1B income tax benefit, $5.0M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 9.0% to $38.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 19.8%, versus 17.4% a year earlier, and operating income rose 2.9× to $1.4B, a 3.6% margin.
Net income rose 3.1× to $4.9B, or $17.69 per share. Operating cash flow was $5.0B and free cash flow $3.7B, versus $1.7B; GE Vernova returned $3.6B through dividends and buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $2.1B tax benefit.
sources: GE Vernova Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
